grades.quote: LR/SC pairs are atomic in the slightly different sense that the memory location in question will not be modified by another hart during the time the original hart holds the reservation.
grades.reason: Explains part of why an SC after an LR may fail: the reservation guarantees the location is not modified by another hart, so an intervening store from another hart breaks the pair. It also says SC is permitted but not guaranteed to succeed. It does not describe the SC result/status value.

grades.quote: sc.w t0, a2, (a0)    # Try to update. bnez t0, cas         # Retry if store-conditional failed.
grades.reason: The LR.W/SC.W compare-and-swap loop shows how the SC result is used: a nonzero result in t0 means the store-conditional failed and the loop retries. This addresses the result-meaning half of the question. It does not explain why SC can fail.
